messages:
sanjay: FYI — following the postmortem, I'm spinning up a short follow-up thread for the GPU surge + autoscale failure. Goal: assign owners, timelines, and a small test plan. Link to PM notes: https://go.redwood/pm/gpu-surge
elaine: Can we split the work into three buckets: quota/backstop, scheduler tuning, and headroom forecasting? I can take headroom planning.
rob: I'll take scheduler tuning. Immediate idea: relax scheduler eviction threshold and tighten batching knobs. Will validate in staging.
marta: I can own quota/backstop. Need to confirm reserved capacity options with procurement and set a fallback quota policy. ETA early next week.
kevin: Who's doing the recurrence detection and alerting updates? We saw the same pattern ~03:00 UTC twice in the last 10 days.
sanjay: @kevin can you own alerts + runbook? Add an automatic digest for surge-patterns. Target for alerting: Wed.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: autoscaler-tweak v2026.03.23-canary -> cluster-alpha (watching).
rob: Test snippet I'll use in staging:
```
# staging scheduler overrides
scheduler.max_workers=120
scheduler.eviction_threshold=0.65
batching.max_batch_delay_ms=12
```
I'll open a PR with the results and latency/cost numbers.
elaine: Add a 2-week recurring checkpoint to validate whether the pattern regresses; rotate owner with oncall. I'll create the calendar item.
kevin: I'll add a Prom rule: `gpu_utilization > 0.85 for 5m` -> page + slack; plus a separate channel-only alert for 1m bursts. Will also wire an eval that compares 99th tail latency pre/post tuning.
sanjay: Quick ownership + deadlines (agreed):
- quota/backstop: Marta — 2026-04-01
- scheduler tuning (staging + canary): Rob — 2026-03-28
- headroom forecasting (runbook + monthly forecast): Elaine — 2026-03-30
- alerts & runbook: Kevin — 2026-03-27
I'll create a GH project and link tasks to owners + include acceptance checks (staging perf, canary stability, cost delta < 10%).
marta: Noted. I'll ping procurement today and attach vendor quota options to the GH task. :thumbsup:
rob: Staging tests scheduled Thu 09:00 PST. Will post perf table after runs.
elaine: I'll add the final writeup to the ops handbook at /runbooks/gpu-surge-signals and include diagrams of normal vs surge headroom.
sanjay: Thanks — if nobody objects I'll create the project board and assign tasks by EOD. Small ask: everyone add one minimal test case to their PR describing the regression guard.
kevin: Will do. I'll also write a short FAQ for oncall about when to flip to reserved capacity vs relying on autoscale.
sanjay: Perfect. Closing the loop here — will follow up with the GH link.
